LightningComponentBundle.masterLabel: CCO FR - Resume de Visite IA
LightningComponentBundle.description: Resume IA (Agentforce / Einstein) de la visite courante (Visit__c, pattern Retail Execution de la lib). Zero managed package.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Overrides the default header title ('Compte-rendu de visite' / 'Visit debrief').

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card icon
property.description: Lightning icon shown in the card header. Keep standard:* icons for homogeneity with the other sefr* cards.

property.name: promptTemplateApiName
property.label: Einstein Prompt Template API Name (optional)
property.description: DeveloperName of a Flex Prompt Template taking Input:Visit__c + Input:ClientContext (string) and returning JSON { summary, keyPoints[], actions[] }. If blank or thin, the component falls back to a deterministic rich summary built from the sibling-captured context (shelf PDL, ruptures, order lines…).
